Laksanakan tugas penguatkuasaan, jaga keselamatan kem, dan kendalikan insiden domestik.

games.name: [Summer] Plantitos Paradise
games.desc:
Dig. Mutate. Collect. Craft. REPEAT! 🌿

Welcome to Trowel a Plant — the wildest prehistoric plant game on Roblox!

Grab your Trowel and explore an ancient world bursting with rare plants, wild mutations, and adorable companions. The more you dig, the rarer your finds!

✨ What you can do:
🌱 Trowel rare prehistoric plants all over the map
🔮 Mutate your plants into something with the help of Insects
🦋 Unlock cute Companions to supercharge your Journey
⚒️ Upgrade your Trowel — 8 tiers from Sprout all the way to Shroomix
🧪 Craft powerful plants and one-of-a-kind Companions
🤝 Trade rare plants with friends and flex your collection!

The rarest plant in the world is out there. 
Will you be the one to find it? 🏆

[How To Play]
• Trowel plants across the map
• Place in your vase to mutate and earn Sunshine
• Upgrade your Trowel to unlock more power
• Use Insect to trigger rare mutations
• Craft plants + Companions and trade with other players!
